notes.title: Cats Adventure Playtest v0.2 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! The Playtest v0.2 version of Cats Adventure is now live. This update brings multiple optimizations and new content, aiming to deliver a smoother and richer gaming experience! 🎮✨

🔧 Update Details

✅ Audio Optimization  
- Comprehensive sound effect adjustments for more impactful combat and immersive environments!  
- Improved skill sound effects for more exciting battle experiences!  

🎭 New Heroes Arrive  
- Multiple new heroes are now available, each with unique skill mechanics - come experience their power!  

🐞 Bug Fixes  
- Fixed scene stuttering issues for smoother performance!  
- Resolved abnormal skill effect display bugs.  
- Other known issues addressed for improved stability!  

Your feedback is very important!
We attach great importance to the opinions of players! After experiencing the Playtest, please contact us in the Steam discussion forum or through the following methods to share your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback will help us create better games! 
Feedback form: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wvvrCmceTfME1oMOaaGXl9EC35zEbnsa1UuXP7S9IgU/edit?hl=zh-cn&gid=0#gid=0
We will provide free keys for the official version of Cats Adventure game to players who provide effective bug feedback!
discard： https://discord.gg/q5u3USXR
You can also watch our videos anytime
Youtube： https://www.youtube.com/ @Catsadventure-f9w
 
Share your experience!
If you enjoy Cats Adventure, don't forget to share your game screenshots or videos on social media and tag them with # Cats Adventure and # Steamplaytest, allowing more players to join our adventure journey!

Thank you for your support!
Cats Adventure Development Team
